referenceName: McAlpine sanctuary wordmark and room index

source.name: McAlpine
source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested on 2026-09-25 that clearance covers full-page screenshot retention, derivative prompts, and sending screenshots to the pipeline model as visual reference. The source-specific grant was not attached.

provenance.capture: Full-page direct-site captures at 1440x1000 and 390x844 after scrolling the full page to trigger any reveal behavior and eager-loading its images. The browser viewport was sized to 1440px desktop and 390px mobile content widths; no site content was modified.
provenance.attribution: McAlpine is the captured website. Internal reference only; no screenshot or source image redistribution.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: An almost monochrome architecture practice presentation opens on a quiet exterior material image with an oversized refined serif wordmark. A single centered label and film/poster frame lead into a vertical list of evocative project names, then a dark full-width navigation and contact close. Large white spaces and a narrow serif index set the pace; all source projects, images, names and claims are McAlpine content.

heroGeometry.mode: full-bleed architectural texture with oversized wordmark
heroGeometry.alignment: wordmark centered over quiet masonry/landscape image; utility controls remain tiny at top edge
heroGeometry.viewport: image and brand expression dominate the opening; a concise service/location statement remains accessible in HTML

navigationGeometry.placement: small top-corner controls over the image
navigationGeometry.mobile: menu and wordmark are compact; no persistent pill navigation

typography.scale: large brand masthead, small single labels, refined vertical project names

palette.contrastIntent: restrained monochrome, with brand text readable on the photo and high contrast in the closing panel

imageTreatment.mode: atmospheric architectural material image and one cinematic presentation frame
imageTreatment.crop: full-bleed opening, restrained centered media frame, minimal image chapter
imageTreatment.focalPoint: texture, branch shadows and architectural material rather than people

servicePresentation.pattern: narrow vertical typographic index of service or project chapters
servicePresentation.interaction: direct anchors from the index; keep labels meaningful and touch-safe

ctaPlacement.primary: quiet enquiry control in opening menu and dark closing panel
ctaPlacement.early: one visible enquiry link after the wordmark statement

motion.primitive: slow reveal for image/presentation chapter only
motion.library: native scroll reveal or a short accessible timeline
motion.reducedMotion: show a still image and all chapter content in order

rules: keep wordmark within the image-safe area
stack the presentation frame at natural ratio
show local scope before the chapter index
stack final navigation and contact routes

prohibitedPatterns: copying McAlpine name, logo, source image, projects, names, or film
using source project labels as client service claims
unexplained empty screen before useful content
unverified team, awards, addresses or outcomes
using this pattern for urgent service businesses

requiredSignatureElements.description: quiet architectural image with large centered wordmark
single cinematic image or static poster chapter
dark contact and navigation closing plane

acceptanceChecks: opening retains atmosphere without hiding actual service/location information
the index contains verified service or project labels
primary enquiry remains findable on mobile
no source project, imagery, name or claim is reused
no blank area pushes the main action unreasonably far down

review.scope: direct-site desktop/mobile capture, source-specific mechanics prompt and requester attestation; no source grant file uploaded
